daily_report_items: COIN lower-Bollinger transition on 2026-07-31 was classified as risk, not opportunity; the later full review retained Strong Sell / Avoid, allocation ineligibility, and no paper action.

evidence.claim: The deterministic packet records an entered lower-Bollinger transition on 2026-07-31 after COIN fell from USD 165.47999572753906 on 2026-07-02 to USD 146.25999450683594, a -0.1161469767762662652627794137 period return, with 20,870,300 shares traded on the final session.

The SEC submissions index identifies accession 0001679788-26-000088 as Coinbase's Form 10-Q, filed 2026-07-30 for the quarter ended 2026-06-30. The maintained review records Q2 transaction revenue down 22% year over year, subscription and services revenue down 12%, and a USD 359 million net loss; these conditions support risk context but do not identify a new buy catalyst for the exact price move.

The completed 2026-08-21 security review already records the exact July 2 through July 31 decline and later found no newer issuer operating filing to alter the thesis. It retained Strong Sell / Avoid, allocation ineligibility and no strategy or signal, so a second research change or follow-up would duplicate accepted work.

summary: Classified the 2026-07-31 COIN lower-Bollinger transition as risk, not an opportunity: the 11.61% decline occurred alongside the July 23 Form 8-K and July 30 Q2 Form 10-Q, whose reported cycle-sensitive revenue decline, net loss, concentration, debt and dilution risks do not establish a buy zone. The subsequent 2026-08-21 full review already incorporated the exact period and retained Strong Sell / Avoid, allocation ineligibility and no strategy or signal; no bounded follow-up remains justified.
